reviews.text: I absolutely love this mascara. It really does a great job of achieving defined lashes. It lasts a long time but also isn’t a chore to remove.
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢支睫毛膏。佢真係做到根根分明嘅效果。夠持久但又唔難卸。

reviews.text:
Cách đặt đúng (quan trọng hơn loại cây)

Đứng ngoài cửa nhìn vào nhà:
 • Đặt lệch sang một bên, không chắn giữa cửa
 • Cao khoảng đầu gối – hông là đẹp
 • Nước luôn sạch, không đục

👉 Phong thuỷ cửa ưu tiên khí đi vào nhẹ nhàng, không bị chặn.

⸻

Nếu bạn muốn, mình chỉ luôn cho bạn vị trí đặt bên trái hay bên phải cửa để hút tài tốt hơn (hai bên ý nghĩa khác nhau hoàn toàn).
Bạn mô tả giúp mình: cửa nhà mở vào bên trái hay bên phải?
reviews.zh:
擺放正確嘅方法（比起植物種類更重要）

喺門外望入屋：
• 擺歪一邊，唔好擋正門口
• 大概膝頭到髖骨嘅高度最靚
• 水要保持乾淨，唔可以濁

👉 風水門口最緊要係氣可以輕柔入屋，唔好被擋住。

⸻

如果你想，我可以畀你建議擺門口左邊定右邊可以更好吸財（兩邊意義完全唔同）。
你可以話畀我知：你屋企道門係向左手邊定右手邊開？

reviews.text: Goood!!! The color is nature. It would make your lashes longer and keep the curl. The brush is also easy to apply. Recommend!!
reviews.zh: 好正！！！顏色好自然。會令你睫毛更長同keep到捲度。掃頭都好易用。推薦！！

reviews.text: Great shaped wand, makes my lashes look extra long but ONLY issue for me is that it's SOOO difficult to take off!! It takes AGES and I've used different make up removers as well.
reviews.zh: 支掃形狀好好，令到我嘅睫毛睇落特別長，但係我唯一嘅問題係好難卸！！用咗好耐都卸唔走，我已經用過唔同嘅卸妝產品。

reviews.text: The wand on this mascara is certainly unique and i don’t think i’ve ever seen one just like this before. It makes it easy to put on and can reach my inner lashes which is what i like. The mascara isn’t hard to remove
reviews.zh: 呢支睫毛膏嘅掃頭確實好獨特，我諗我從來都未見過類似嘅設計。佢好易上妝，而且可以搽到內眼睫毛，我鍾意呢一點。呢支睫毛膏唔難卸。

reviews.text:
I wear false lashes so volume wasn't important to me for the purposes I was using it for but if I were to use this on its own, it basically doesn't add any volume nor length. 
It does hold lashes for a solid amount of time, but its not smudge proof. 
I won't repurchase because its not useful to wear it on its own, isn't smudge proof, and hold is average.
reviews.zh:
我平時戴假眼睫毛，所以對我嘅用途嚟講，豐盈度唔係重點。但如果淨係用佢嘅話，基本上無論豐盈定延長都無效果。
佢嘅捲翹持久度算係穩定，但就唔防暈染。
我唔會再回購，因為淨用無用，又唔防暈，捲翹度亦只係一般。

reviews.text: I think the best think about this is that is long lasting and doesn't smudge. It isn't particularly volumizing, nor does it make your lashes look thick and curled. It mostly just separates lashes.
reviews.zh: 我覺得佢最出色嘅地方係持久同唔暈染。佢唔算特別豐盈，亦唔會令睫毛睇起嚟又粗又翹，主要係將睫毛梳開。

reviews.text: Brush is really cool! And the color is good. This looks very natural, I’m always having a hard time finding mascaras that don’t make my lashes clumpy and this is great. Wish it held a curl better though.
reviews.zh: 支掃好正！顏色都唔錯。效果好自然，我一直都好難搵到一啲唔會令睫毛結成一嚿嚿嘅睫毛膏，呢支就做到。不過希望捲翹持久度再好啲就好喇。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
